title: With Vendor Order Management Create & Edit, a bill at your location is a link
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access", "Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit" but not "Vendor Order Management → View", with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-16 User with the custom role ZZAUTOTEST S7-16 Role; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has an unpaid bill {Bill-A} received at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-16 Bills.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Vendor-A}'s group expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it is a link.
  • Step 2: {Bill-A}'s delivery opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R1: “A document number is a link only when the user has the permission to open it and can open it in its own location; otherwise it shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R6: “A bill at the user's current location opens its delivery, as today. A bill at another location shows as plain text, because the bill page cannot switch location.”
  • Story 7 Prerequisites: “A bill opens for a user with 'Vendor Order Management → View' or 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit'.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png: figure "Links only where they can open" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"
  • ar-ap-p5-every-invoice-number-is-a-link.png: figure "Every invoice number is a link" (Production (before)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style. S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2." (caption of "Links only where they can open")
  • "Signed in to Heavy Duty, the Lethbridge invoices (S3-) are links too." (caption of "Every invoice number is a link")
